## Description
Provide a concise explanation of what this pull request changes and why.

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change adding functionality)
- [ ] Source adapter (new opportunity source integration)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that causes existing behavior to change)
- [ ] Documentation update

## Checklist
- [ ] My code follows the code style and guidelines of this project.
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my own code.
- [ ] I have commented my code, particularly in hard-to-understand areas.
- [ ] My changes generate no new warnings or console errors.
- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works.
- [ ] New and existing automated tests pass locally (`npm test`).
- [ ] Production build succeeds (`npm run build`).
- [ ] No secrets, private credentials, or service-role keys are committed.
